name: sober
description: Display days since getting away from something

paragraphs: The goal of sober is to display different information on a date on which people got away from something like chococale, meat, cigarettes, drug, etc. For example there should be displayed, how much money one saved throug abstinence. There should also be information about future outcomes, like how much money you will save when staying abstinent. Also there will be displayed on which dates there is a double, triple, quattruble.
